datasets.caveat: Controlled CSS X-only adaptations of BeamSearch and RelayBP on all original Roffe rates; unchanged canonical float64 min-sum sweeps, original-syndrome stopping and independent logical evaluation. No circuit-paper reproduction, Pauli Q-BP result or global-optimum claim. LER-first finite numerical/topology/memory tuning, separate coarse/finalist/fresh cohorts. Mean latency targets0.5/1/2/4 times same-CPU undamped BP+OSD0; actual timing and approximate1%-bin tail quantiles are explicit. All branches, discarded work, masking, random draws and selection included. Different selected controls are never silently pooled.
datasets.label: Roffe X-only: tuned beam search and RelayBP latency tradeoffs
